texts.en:
An abundant species of herbivorous megafauna have begun to disrupt the energy production of [Root.GetName]. In dramatic displays of mass suicide, they are frying themselves alive on our power stations.

The animals are extremely driven in their purpose, breaking through fences around our energy grids to reach their goal. Energy generation is suffering as a result of this peculiar behavior.

This has however led to the unexpected benefit of increased food production, with [Owner.GetColonistPlural] discovering that the flesh of the creatures is highly delicious.

The species plays a pivotal role in the ecosystem of the planet. At the current rate of these incidents they will drive themselves to extinction.

texts.zh:
关于[Root.GetName]上的物种自杀我们获得了极具价值的洞见。

这些巨型动物是功能性失明的，它们利用回声定位来观察和识别彼此。我们怀疑电网发出的频率超过了他们敏锐听觉所能忍受的程度，引发了对我们发电站的攻击行为。

除此之外，我们还了解到它们独特的消化酶可以作为冶金冶炼的催化剂。初步试验表明合金产量有望提高。

尽管有了这些发现，我们距离恢复正常的能源生产还有很长的路要走。我们的科学家将继续调查这个问题。
texts.en:
We have gained valuable insights on the suicidal fauna species on [Root.GetName].

These megafauna are functionally blind, using echolocation to see and identify one another. We suspect that our energy grids are emitting a frequency that is overwhelming their acute hearing, triggering this aggressive behavior toward our power stations.

In addition to this, we have learned that their unique digestive enzymes can act as a catalyst in metallurgic refining. Initial tests show potential in improving our alloy production.

Despite these discoveries, we are still a long way off from resuming normal energy production. Our scientists continue to investigate the issue.

texts.zh:
我们已经辨明了[Root.GetName]上的生物产生自杀式攻击冲动的原因。

对其回声定位系统和社会行为的进一步研究调查揭示了一个令人震惊的事实：他们的求偶呼叫和我们电网发出的噪音几乎处于完全一致的频率。

我们可以利用这些知识很方便地引导这些生物到特定的捕获装置中。饱餐一顿吧。
texts.en:
We have identified the cause of the aggressive suicidal impulses of the creatures on [Root.GetName].

Further observational study of their echolocation and social behaviors have revealed the shocking truth; their mating calls share an almost identical frequency to the sounds generated by our energy grids.

Conveniently, we can use this knowledge to channel the creatures into specialized harvesters. Let us feast.

我们可以复制这些巨兽的叫声，将它们的迁徙路线引导向远离我们殖民地的方向，稳定其种群数量。如此我们便能从它们的遗弃物中收获催化酶来促进我们的合金产出，同时继续研究它们独特的生理学。

在另一方面，

这些生物成了[Root.GetName]的主食之一。

我们很容易制造特化的带电捕捉装置高效地处理这些动物而无需干扰能量产出。
texts.en:
We have identified the cause of the aggressive suicidal impulses of the creatures on [Root.GetName].

Further observational study of their echolocation and social behaviors have revealed the shocking truth; their mating calls share an almost identical frequency to the sounds generated by our energy grids.

We could recreate the cries of these beasts to divert their migration paths away from our colony, thus stabilizing their population. This will allow us to harvest catalytic enzymes from their droppings to boost alloy production, while continuing our study of their unique physiology.

On the other [Owner.GetSpeciesHandName],

These creatures have become a staple of the [Root.GetName] diet.

We could easily create specialized electrified harvesters to efficiently process these animals without disrupting energy production.

summary.text:
# 自然触电 / Nature Shock

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC: BioGenesis

## 如何开始 How it starts

殖民地满1年时随机事件池以20/510抽中隐藏门卫 strange_worlds.50（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3730）；非AI与默认国家类型限制见前提，门卫在其后每180天（随机至3420天）检查一次殖民地是否有能源区划或能源网络/枢纽建筑。

A colony turning 1 year old can draw the hidden gatekeeper strange_worlds.50 (20/510, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3730); hidden strange_worlds.51 then re-checks every 180 days (random up to 3420) until the colony has an energy district or energy grid / nexus building.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

strange_worlds.55“自然触电”（巨型草食动物撞上能源设施自杀；非有机/岩石或机器人物种看到另一版正文）→ 270天后 strange_worlds.60“催化生理”（社会研究、合金）→ 180天后 strange_worlds.65“动物磁吸”：a“收集它们的粪便”给星球 pm_catalytic_excrement 修正；b“盛宴！”（吞噬蜂群专属，或普通版）给 pm_frying_fauna_2，演化捕食者另得DNA进度。

strange_worlds.55 "Nature Shock" (megafauna suicide on the power stations; lithoid or robotic species see another text) -> 270 days later strange_worlds.60 "Catalytic Physiology" (society research, alloys) -> 180 days later strange_worlds.65 "Animal Magnetism": a "Harvest their droppings" gives the planet pm_catalytic_excrement; b "Time to feast!" (Devouring Swarm version or default) gives pm_frying_fauna_2, and Evolutionary Predators also DNA progress.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

65 的 a 与 b 互斥（吞噬蜂群无法选 a）。

In 65, a and b are exclusive (Devouring Swarm cannot pick a).
